entities.summary: Anjali Sud is an American businesswoman and technology and media executive. She is the CEO of Tubi, the free entertainment streaming service owned by Fox Corporation. Sud was previously CEO of Vimeo for six years, until August 2023. She was appointed to the position in July 2017 and took the company public in May 2021. Sud sits on the boards of SiriusXM, Dolby Laboratories and Change.org, is a designated Young Global Leader of the World Economic Forum, and was listed as one of Fortune's 40 Under 40 rising business leaders in 2018.
